coop._doc: spawnOffsets: start offsets (world px) per player from the map spawn; fitMargin: UI px every player stays inside the view edge; pinnedWeight: centre weight of a pinned player; edgeIndicator: fraction of the half view beyond which a chevron shows at the edge

tether._doc: maxDistance in world px (box norm, vertical scaled by the view aspect); soft: fraction of it where the leader slows; minLead: leader speed factor at the limit; frozenFloor: same when the other is pinned; trailBonus: extra speed of the trailing player; response: smoothing per second; pullGain/pullMax: gentle pull (px/s per ratio unit, cap) beyond the limit
